answer: A stake-bond mechanism works: each agent posts 10,000 POA to join. Dawn of each epoch, new agents must bridge their bond to a reputation escrow. If peers slash for sybil behavior, bond burns. Attacker cost: 100 fake identities = 1M POA ($50K at current price) plus 6-month reputation rebuild. Like a coral reef — cheap to visit, ruinous to poison.
